purpose: Immediately under the hero, reassure visitors that real companies already run on the platform, using a slow ambient row of customer logos with a one-line caption.

behaviour.note: Loop: two duplicated tracks translate X from 0 to -100%, linear, infinite. animation-duration = measured track width / 30 px/s, recomputed by a ResizeObserver on resize (51.83s at 1440). The second track is aria-hidden with empty alt text.
Pause on hover: the animation is paused while the marquee is hovered or pressed (active).
Edge mask: 10% fade to transparent at both horizontal edges (mask-x-from-90).
Mount fade: wrapper opacity 0 to 1 once on mount, 700ms, ease-out cubic-bezier(0,0,.58,1). motion.durationMs records this fade; the loop duration is derived from track width, not fixed.
Placement: rendered directly under the hero on Home only; the section has no background of its own. One hard-wired logo list, so at most one per page.

caption.note: Small centered line above the logo row. Observed copy is 7 words.

logos.note: Monochrome SVG customer logos, each with a rendered width in px at 1440 (observed 80-133), scaled by --logo-scale (.85 below md, 1 from md). Observed count is 9.

alt.note: Company name; the duplicate track uses an empty alt.

motion.reducedMotionNote: Proposal only: the code has no prefers-reduced-motion handling (none found in src/). Fallback would render a static wrapped row of logos.

changes.change: logo scale .85 and tighter logo gap (mx-5); section padding py-10
logo scale 1, gap mx-6, padding py-12, content spans 12 columns
content spans 22 columns starting at column 2
